source: MMGPL Medical Image Analysis 2024 Figure 6 text prompts, frozen for the formal run
MCI_note: MMGPL source descriptions refer to LMCI and are used as TADPOLE MCI semantic proxies. TADPOLE labels are unchanged.
g1_pen: Frozen vectors grouped by class, with three-class semantic softmax. The original PEN MLP and local/global fusion remain unchanged.
query_adapter: L2-normalize frozen 12x1024 RN50 features in float64, form the symmetric 12x12 Gram matrix, use deterministic Cholesky, pad the 12x12 factor with zeros to 12x32, cast to model dtype after Gram verification.
legacy_P_text_path: Preserved in the query payload and history source manifest for lineage inspection only. It is not the formal MMGPL-12 adapter.
